title: Naomi Osaka defeats Siniakova 6-2, 5-7, 6-1 on September 3 to reach US Open third round
dek: Naomi Osaka defeated Katerina Siniakova 6-2, 5-7, 6-1 in the second round of the US Open on September 3, 2026, advancing to the third round. The two-time US Open champion recovered from losing the second set to dominate the third.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Osaka beat Siniakova 6-2, 5-7, 6-1 on September 3 to reach the US Open third round, extending a year marked by strong results at Roland Garros, Wimbledon, and Bad Homburg.
bottom_line: Osaka's third-round opponent will be determined by ongoing matches, and her ability to navigate the noise and distraction at Flushing while maintaining the form she showed in the third set against Siniakova will test whether her mid-year resurgence can sustain through the tournament's back half.
body:
Naomi Osaka defeated Katerina Siniakova 6-2, 5-7, 6-1 in the second round of the US Open on September 3, 2026, advancing to the third round, according to Guardian Sport.
Osaka, a two-time US Open champion who won titles in 2018 and 2020, has been steadily building form through 2026. She reached the French Open fourth round, the Wimbledon quarter-finals (where she defeated world No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka in round four, per Guardian Sport), and the Bad Homburg final a week before Wimbledon.
Osaka advanced past Anastasia Zakharova in the first round, 7-6 (6), 7-6 (3), according to Guardian Sport. The Siniakova match tested her composure, as she dominated the first set before losing the second before reasserting control in the decider.
Guardian Sport reports Elena Rybakina, the second seed, is a potential fourth-round opponent for Osaka. In other second-round results, Iga Swiatek, the eighth seed and 2022 champion, defeated Nadia Podoroska 6-3, 6-2. Marie Bouzkova, the 25th seed, beat British qualifier Harriet Dart 6-2, 6-2. Félix Auger-Aliassime, the third seed and semi-finalist in 2025, lost to Karen Khachanov 6-7 (5), 6-3, 6-2, 6-2, per Guardian Sport. Auger-Aliassime struggled with dizziness and illness during the match.
In her post-match press conference, Osaka addressed the atmosphere at the tournament, citing the presence of approximately 100 credentialed content creators at the event, according to Awful Announcing. During her first-round match against Zakharova, the chair umpire had to address a rowdy suite. Osaka stated: "Today, the umpire, she told everyone to be quiet more than I've ever heard an umpire tell a crowd to be quiet." She added that while she was not bothered by content creators' camera lights, she disliked the noise. Osaka said: "If you come to a sporting event, you have to respect the sport. I feel like it's common courtesy to read up on the sport. Especially the etiquette."
